title: Fraud Detection System
description: End-to-end ML pipeline on 6.3M+ financial transaction records for real-time fraud detection. Applied StandardScaler/OneHotEncoder preprocessing and class-weight balancing to handle severe class imbalance, then deployed as a live Streamlit app.

title: Telecom Customer Churn Analysis
description: EDA on 7,043 customer records to uncover churn drivers such as contract type, tenure, and payment method, with retention recommendations based on the findings.

title: Netflix Content Data Analysis
description: EDA on 9,827 movies with feature engineering (genre expansion, vote categorization) to surface content trends and audience preference patterns.
